basic_info.description: Classic 1925 barrel-front fixer is an amazing opportunity for buyers who want to renovate and design an incredible home. Features on the main level: Two uniquely framed skylights in the formal dining room, original wall sconces and built in cabinets that frame the wood burning fireplace. Investors and Flippers...you will appreciate the extensive basement with high ceilings for potential development. If the furnace, hot water heater and sewer line are relocated and the false walls removed, the area could accommodate 4 vehicles with room to spare. The deep and level back yard was recently cleared so one can visualize a landscaped retreat. The electric service panel is newer and the garage door was replaced. L-Taraval streetcar and the 29 Sunset bus lines are within walking distance. Appreciate the convenience and FREE parking at Lakeshore Plaza to shop at Lucky market or Ross, enjoy a meal at one of the restaurants or coffee at Peet's and run your mailing errands. Stonestown Galleria is also nearby with Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, Target, a variety of shops and restaurants and the Regal movie theater. Two Sunday farmers markets are at Stonestown and 37th Ave. Prestigious Lowell High School and St. Ignatius College-Preparatory School are in the vicinity. A diamond in the rough.
